title: Cervical Strength
summary: Mon/Wed/Fri/Sun, after Cervical AM. Lower traps behind; deep neck flexors, core and serratus in front, to reverse forward head posture. Light loads only until a PT clears progression.

steps.name: Prone Y Raise
steps.cue: Face down, forehead on towel, chin tucked, thumbs up. Arms overhead at 45°; lift by drawing shoulder blades down and together. Hold 3 sec. No shrugging; head stays down.

steps.name: Prone T Raise
steps.cue: Arms straight out to the sides, thumbs up. Lift by squeezing the shoulder blades together; hold 3 sec. Neck relaxed, forehead stays on the towel.

steps.name: Prone W Raise
steps.cue: Elbows bent, hands by shoulders, thumbs up. Pull elbows back and down to lift; hold 3 sec. Stop if the neck takes over from the shoulder blades.

steps.name: Band Pull-Aparts
steps.cue: Light band at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull apart until it touches the chest, squeeze 2 sec, return slowly. Chin tuck throughout; shoulders down. Stop if the neck tenses.

steps.name: Chin-Tuck Head Lift
steps.cue: On back, knees bent. Nod chin first, then lift head ~1 inch keeping the nod; hold 5 sec, build to 10. Lower before the chin pokes forward. Too hard? Prop head and shoulders on pillows. Stop if arm symptoms.

steps.name: Dead Bug
steps.cue: On back, arms up, hips and knees at 90°. Exhale, ribs down, low back gently into the floor. Slowly lower opposite arm and leg, then return. Head stays down, neck relaxed. Stop the rep if the low back arches.

steps.name: Serratus Wall Slide
steps.cue: Forearms on the wall, pinkies toward it. Push the wall away to spread the shoulder blades, then slide arms up into a V and back down. Shoulders away from ears, chin tucked. Stop if hand tingling increases.
